Name: Free Cactuses Recolor
Author: ashleyketchumtr
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][img]https://imgur.com/t6llNEw.png[/img]﻿﻿
[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/yhGEUJb.png[/img]﻿

[b]Free Cactuses Recolor[/b] is a simple yet elegant mod that gives a fresh, darker, and desaturated look to the free cactuses you receive at the Desert Festival. This mod replaces the original vibrant cactus sprites with a more subdued and moody colorway, perfect for players who prefer a more desaturated aesthetic.[/size]

The cactuses are randomized every year! If you want a specific style, try using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿ to get the one you want![/font]


[img]https://imgur.com/WIj4nRN.png[/img]﻿

[font=Georgia]Ensure you have[b] Content Patcher[/b] installed.
[/font][font=Georgia]Download and extract into your Mods folder.[/font]

There should be no compatibility issues, unless there is another CP mod that affects the cactuses.


[img]https://imgur.com/XFFVd77.png[/img]﻿
